hits.about: Vista 2 by Reportage Properties is an upscale residential development that presents studios, 1, 2, 3, 4 bedroom apartments located at Al Maryah Island, Abu Dhabi.The project offers an incomparable lifestyle embracing the shades of blue. Located in the heart of a free zone, Vista 2 is a perfect opportunity for living and Investment. This exceptionally designed community is an exquisite collection of premium homes and retail shops perfectly placed for you to wake up to views of gleaming white yachts, and walk up to Abu Dhabi’s longest canal. Within this vibrant area and the resort-like community in the heart of Abu Dhabi and an international financial-free zone, a work-life balance is never easier to maintain.Vista 2 is perfectly designed to embrace the colors of nature and blend with the beautiful white Yachts. With the modern facades and high quality-finishing, Vista 2 becomes an icon of elegance, simplicity, and fine taste.If you are a resident, be ready to welcome the astonishing views into your perfectly designed apartment. Every bit of space is thought of and well lit, reflected by a neutral color palette and high-quality finishing that always meet the expectations of those seeking serenity and tranquility. Kitchens and Bathrooms are never a small detail; they are perfectly designed to meet your expectations of functionality and refined taste.Al Maryah Island is home to Abu Dhabi Global Market, the award-winning IFC and governing authority. ​The Island promises you luxury retail and high-end dining experiences, premium hospitality, and world-class healthcare at Cleveland Clinic Abu Dhabi, while also being surrounded by a striking waterfront promenade, which hosts some of Abu Dhabi’s most exciting events.
hits.title: Vista 2
